Guidance & outlook: We expect 5 to 10 basis points increase in next quarter.

As said in the last call, competition and retention of customers may bring down the yields going forward, and we anticipate a reduction of 10 basis points in the yield on advances in the next quarter.
With the current visibility, NIM may remain at the levels of 4% plus in the next quarter.
Growth & demand: As of 30th June 2026, the bank's total business reached INR2,27,267 crores, reflecting our sustained growth momentum in the first quarter with an overall business increase of 6% quarter-on-quarter and year -on-year growth of 16%.
